Moreover, I believe there is potential to refine and elevate this technique to Celestial-rank in the future."
"Supreme-rank, huh?
I guess that means I qualify for a promotion, right?" Yuan said with a smile.
Lord Zi fell silent for a moment before laughing out loud, "You are correct.
I will keep my word and promote you.
Congratulations, you've become the highest-ranking member of our Martial Tower in a record-breaking time."
"Thank you."
"Now that you have full access to the Martial Tower, where would you like to go?" Lord Zi asked.
"What's on the highest floor?" Yuan asked.
"That would be my private living quarters.
Unfortunately, it is only accessible to me," said Lord Zi.
"Ah, I see.
Then I'll just take a look at the other floors."
"In that case, I will return to my own work.
I can't wait to see how you'll contribute to the Martial Tower in the future."
After Lord Zi left, Yuan made his way to the 28th floor of the tower, where all the Mythic-rank techniques were stored.
However, upon arriving at his destination, Yuan was surprised to see not a single Mythic-rank technique available.
He went to the 29th floor next, and sure enough, there was not a single Supreme-rank technique available.
However, Yuan wasn't too shocked, only slightly disappointed.
"I bet the real Martial Tower would be filled with martial techniques on these floors," he muttered to himself.
Despite anticipating that the 30th floor would likely be empty, Yuan decided to investigate anyway.
Upon arriving and spotting a single technique available on the otherwise vacant floor, he realized his effort had been well worth it.
Yuan immediately approached the technique, which rested elegantly on a stand crafted from fine jade.
With curiosity and anticipation, he began reading the technique.
Sometime later.
<Shadow Veil learned>
[Shadow Veil]
[Rank: Celestial]
[Mastery Level: 1]
[Description: Envelope yourself in a veil of shadow, completely erasing your presence.
While under the shadow's embrace, you become undetectable by divine sense and all detection techniques.]

Although Celestial Overlord Qiang had given him a technique that concealed his presence, Shadow Veil was incomparably better and could rival even Yingzi's natural invisible presence as a Shadow Dweller.
'Actually, this technique was most likely inspired by Shadow Dwellers and their lack of presence...' Yuan thought to himself.
'This technique is also perfect for this trial.
With this technique, I will be able to spy on the Breakthrough Towers with more ease.'
The first thought that crossed Yuan's mind after acquiring the concealment technique was to use it to explore the highest floor of the Martial Tower—Lord Zi's living quarters.
However, after giving it more consideration, Yuan decided to hold off until he had visited the other Breakthrough Towers.
Sneaking into Lord Zi's quarters while he was still in the tower posed unnecessary risks.
'I should lure him out of the tower before I investigate his place,' Yuan concluded, formulating a more cautious plan.
With that in mind, Yuan decided to visit the next Breakthrough Tower.
Meanwhile, Tan Songyun was utterly bewildered after witnessing Yuan create a Supreme-rank technique in just a single month.
Adding to her astonishment were the numerous other achievements he had demonstrated during the trial.
'Not only can he craft Empyrean-rank treasures with ease, but he's also capable of creating powerful martial techniques in such a short time.
His talent is simply outrageous...' she thought, swallowing nervously as she recalled Yuan mentioning his previous lives.

chapters.title: Chapter 1772 Cultivation Tower
paragraphs: After learning the martial technique Shadow Veil, Yuan left the Martial Tower to visit another Breakthrough Tower. However, upon leaving the tower, he noticed an individual standing right outside.
This person was Apprentice Huan, who had decided to remain outside the Martial Tower to wait for Yuan. After all, he couldn't return to the Metal Tower without Yuan.
The moment Apprentice Huan noticed Yuan coming out, he rushed over to block his path.
"You're really persistent, I'll give you that," Yuan said.
"I will not return to the Metal Tower without you."
"In that case..."

"You can kill me if you want, but I will not budge," Apprentice Huan said, his voice unexpectedly calm. "My life will be over if I return to the Metal Tower without you, anyway." His usual arrogant and haughty demeanor was nowhere to be seen, replaced by a quiet resignation.
"I won't kill you, but I also won't return to the Metal Tower with you."
Yuan walked around Apprentice Huan and made his way to the teleportation formation.
Apprentice Huan didn't say anything and followed him behind in silence.
Yuan pretended he wasn't even there and continued walking.
Soon, he arrived at the teleportation formation.
When the individual managing the formation noticed the badge on Yuan's chest, he immediately lowered his head and spoke in a respectful tone, "How can I assist you today, Senior?"
"Bring me to the Cultivation Tower," Yuan responded.
"Right away."
Once Yuan entered the teleportation formation and disappeared, Apprentice Huan stepped forward and said, "Take me to the Cultivation Tower as well."
"Y-yes, Senior from the Metal Tower!"

Sometime later, Yuan arrived at the majestic Cultivation Tower, a structure similar in grandeur to the Martial Tower but exuding a vastly different atmosphere. The air around the Cultivation Tower felt serene and profound, filled with a sense of deep focus and spiritual energy.

Moreover, the Cultivation Tower was a magnet for spiritual energy, drawing it in such immense quantities that the surrounding city was shrouded in a visible fog of dense spiritual energy. When spiritual energy gathers in one place and becomes highly concentrated, it condenses into a mist-like form, making it visible to the naked eye.

Because of this immense concentration of spiritual energy, the area surrounding the Cultivation Tower became a prime location for cultivators. Only those with significant influence and power were permitted to reside close to the tower, enjoying the richer spiritual energy. Ordinary families and less influential individuals were relegated to the outer areas of the city, far from the tower's core benefits.

As Yuan neared the Cultivation Tower, a guard noticed him and approached with a measured stride. However, the moment the guard's eyes landed on the badge displayed on Yuan's chest, his expression shifted to one of surprise. Without saying a word, the guard hastily turned around and walked away with even larger strides, almost as if running away from a ghost while trying not to look scared.
Outside the Cultivation Tower's entrance, a group of cultivators stood gathered around a single tablet, their eyes fixed on its inscriptions.

Curious, Yuan approached and read the tablet's contents. As expected, it displayed a cultivation technique. However, something about the technique felt off. Yuan couldn't immediately identify what was wrong, but he couldn't shake the strong sense that something wasn't right with it.

After staring intently for a while, Yuan's eyes lit up with a spark of realization. He muttered to himself, "Oh, I see. There's an error in this cultivation technique. No wonder something about it felt off."
When the other cultivators overheard Yuan's words, they instantly snapped their heads in his direction, their eyes wide with shock and disbelief.
"Y-you... do you know where the error is?" one of them suddenly asked.
"Hm? Yes, I do. Ah, this must be the trial." Yuan said with a smile.

While the Martial Tower required participants to improve a martial technique, the Cultivation Tower had a different challenge—identifying the faults or errors within a cultivation technique. This task demanded not only a deep understanding of cultivation principles but also keen eyes to see the flaws.
"He only just got here! How can he see through the flaws so quickly?!" someone there exclaimed.
"Look at the badge on his chest! He's from the Martial Tower!"
"Martial techniques and cultivation techniques are completely different from each other! Just because he's good at one does not mean he's good at the other!"
Most of the people there have been studying the tablet for months, if not years. Although they were aware the cultivation technique had a flaw, they didn't know where to find the error.
"I don't believe you! If you truly believe that you have found the error, then prove it and summon the examiner!" This individual pointed at the bell located right beside the tablet.
Without hesitation, Yuan approached the bell and rang it.
Shortly after the sound of the bell ended, an individual appeared before Yuan like a ghost and asked, "Are you the one who summoned me?"
"Yes," Yuan confirmed.
"Then tell me, where is the error in this cultivation technique? If you fail, you will not have another chance in this lifetime. Understand?"
Yuan nodded and said, "Allow me to demonstrate it."
He sat down and began cultivating using the cultivation technique written on the tablet.

A few minutes later, Yuan recited a specific line from the technique aloud and explained, "This part is the error. At a glance, it might seem fine, but over time, it causes long-term side effects that could damage and ultimately ruin one's spiritual veins."

The examiner stared at Yuan in silence for a long moment before nodding his head, "Congratulations, you have managed to find the error in this cultivation technique. I see that you're already part of the Martial Tower, but we do no discriminate. Do you wish to join our Cultivation Tower, too?"
"Yes, I would like to join the Cultivation Tower."
"Very well. Follow me. I'll give you a tour."
Yuan nodded and followed the examiner inside the tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 1773 Cultivation Tower(2)
paragraphs: As Yuan followed the examiner inside the Cultivation Tower, the man said, "Let me introduce myself first. My name is Ming Wu, and I have been working at the Cultivation Tower for over five thousand years."
"My name is Yuan."
"How long have you been with the Martial Tower?"
"Not long. About a month."
"I see. Then, how much do you know about the Cultivation Tower?" Ming Wu suddenly asked.
"I know that they improve and create cultivation techniques, much like the Martial Tower."

"You're not wrong, but we are much more important than the Martial Tower, no matter how they try to argue otherwise. We are the foundation of the cultivation world. Without cultivation techniques, there would be no cultivators," said Ming Wu.
"Well, I can't argue with that logic."

"At least you're understanding. There are others from the Martial Tower who have joined our Cultivation Tower, but they are all too stubborn to admit that we are more important than them," Ming Wu sighed.
"I won't argue with you over that subject, if that's what you're trying to make me do."
"Then let me ask you—why did you join us?"
"To learn more about cultivation techniques. Is that a bad answer?"

"Not necessarily. I joined the tower myself because I wanted a better cultivation technique. However, as I spent time in this place, I began to learn and understand the importance of cultivation techniques."
"Anyway, the first floor isn't used for anything, and the real tower begins on the second floor."
When they arrived on the second floor, Yuan could see a single individual cultivating in the center of the room.
"The Cultivation Tower has the lowest number of members because we are the hardest to qualify for. After all, we don't want anyone messing up cultivation techniques and potentially crippling people."

"More than half of our members are dedicated to checking cultivation techniques to ensure they are safe to use. The others focus on improving existing cultivation techniques, and very few of us actually create new cultivation techniques."
"I see... And how does one increase their rank in the Cultivation Tower?" Yuan asked a moment later.

"There are only two ranks in the Cultivation Tower," Ming Wu explained. "The first is the Tower Master, and the rest of us share the same rank, so there's no need to concern yourself too much with titles. What differentiates us are our jobs. Of course, seniority still plays a role in our hierarchy."
"So, I have full access to the Cultivation Tower?" Yuan asked.
"You have full access to the resources needed for your specific role," Ming Wu replied. "What exactly do you wish to do at our tower?"
"Am I restricted to one role? What if I wish to do everything?"
Ming Wu's eyes widened at his words.

"While we are not restricted to a single role," Ming Wu cautioned, "you shouldn't bite off more than you can chew—especially since you've only just joined us. Here, you're expected to contribute in all roles simultaneously."
"I have more experience than I look," Yuan said with a calm smile.
Ming Wu scoffed, "I believe you, but you still have no idea how much effort is required. Let me show you."
Ming Wu brought Yuan to an empty floor and handed him two different cultivation techniques.

"This one is a Divine-rank cultivation technique with an error, and this one is a Divine-rank that can be improved. I want you to do both of them. Let's see how long it'll take you to accomplish this task."
Yuan accepted the two cultivation techniques and nodded, "Alright. Any time limit?"
"No, take as long as you need. Here's your badge. Contact me once you're done."
Ming Wu left Yuan alone shortly after.
'It'll probably take him several months to finish.' Ming Wu thought to himself as he left.
However, to Ming Wu's shock, Yuan contacted him before the day was even over.
"What's wrong?" Ming Wu asked after answering Yuan's call through the badge.
"I'm done."
"What?" Ming Wu's face stiffened.
Although he had a good idea of what Yuan meant, he didn't dare to believe it.
"I'm done with both techniques," Yuan elaborated.
"There's no way! Don't lie to me! Although they might've only been Divine-rank cultivation techniques, they're not something you can finish in less than a day!" Ming Wu said.
"I'll only waste my breath trying to convince you with words, so I'll show you. Come find me," said Yuan before hanging up on Ming Wu.
Hearing this, Ming Wu dropped whatever he was doing and rushed back to Yuan's floor.

Seeing Ming Wu before him, Yuan began his demonstration. For the cultivation technique that had an error, Yuan not only pointed out the error but also found a solution for it, something the Cultivation Tower was still working on.
As for the second cultivation technique, which had already been improved by the Cultivation Tower, Yuan managed to improve it with even better results, leaving Ming Wu speechless.
"What do you think? Do I have what it takes to do multiple roles at once?" Yuan asked him with a smile afterward.
In response, Ming Wu retrieved two more cultivation techniques and handed them to Yuan.
"Do the same thing with these two Ancient-rank cultivation techniques. If you can manage to do that, I'll speak with the Tower Master and allow you full access to the Cultivation Tower."
"Deal." Yuan nodded, and he immediately began working on the techniques.
Ming Wu didn't immediately leave this time, as he'd decided to stay behind for a few days to see Yuan's process.

Since it had been a long time since Yuan last worked on improving techniques, he initially took some time to regain his footing. However, as he continued to work, his past life experiences began resurfacing with greater clarity. With each attempt, his ability to identify flaws and implement improvements grew significantly sharper and more profound.
Two days later, Yuan opened his eyes and turned to look at Ming Wu, who immediately swallowed nervously.
"I'm done," he announced with a calm smile on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 1774 Cultivation Tower(3)
paragraphs: "Y-you're done? It's only been two days, you know? There's no way you finished two Ancient-rank techniques in two days," Ming Wu shook his head, refusing to believe Yuan.
"Allow me to prove it."
However, Ming Wu raised his hand and said, "Wait! Let me contact someone first!"
"Give me some time. I'll be back soon."
Without offering any further explanation, Ming Wu turned and left, disappearing to an unknown destination.
A few hours later, Ming Wu returned, but he wasn't alone. Walking beside him was a stunningly beautiful woman, her presence commanding attention with an air of elegance and grace.
"This is the Tower Master," Ming Wu said.

"My name is Meng Xuan. Ming Wu told me that you have managed to improve an Ancient-rank technique and fix another in just two days. I never expected someone from the Martial Tower to have such talents with cultivation techniques. Can you show me how you improved the techniques?" she said.
Yuan nodded and immediately began demonstrating the improved cultivation techniques.
Meng Xuan's eyes widened after seeing the improvements made to the techniques.
Both techniques that Ming Wu had given Yuan as a test were cultivation techniques the Cultivation Tower had planned on working on next, so there was no way Yuan could have cheated.
"Marvelous!" Meng Xuan exclaimed after seeing the improvements.
"Although they're only Ancient-rank techniques, you've managed to improve them so much that they qualify for a rank promotion! This rarely happens to cultivation techniques!" she continued.

Unlike martial techniques, which can often be elevated to higher ranks through improvements due to their inherently adaptable nature, cultivation techniques are far more rigid and complex. They rarely undergo improvements so profound that they result in a promotion of the technique's rank, as their foundational principles are much harder to alter or refine.

"And it only took you two days to do so! Such talents are rarely seen nowadays. How about this? I have been looking for a successor for some time now, but nobody in the Cultivation Tower has managed to impress me. If you can pass one more trial, I can make you the next Tower Master!"

"What?!" Ming Wu exclaimed in shock. "Tower Master, he just joined us recently! If you make him your successor, the others will not be happy about this!" "I know. That's why I want to give him a few more tests. Also, it's not like he'll immediately take my position. I still need to train him," said Meng Xuan.

"Still, that isn't fair to the others, who have been striving to be your successor for many decades!" Ming Wu said. Hearing this, Meng Xuan sneered, "I'm surprised you can utter such words without feeling ashamed. The only thing that matters to me is your talent and ability to improve cultivation techniques. I don't care how long you've been in the Cultivation Tower."
"T-that's..." Ming Wu lowered his head after being lectured by Meng Xuan.
"I'll do it," Yuan responded a moment later.
"Great."

Meng Xuan retrieved ten techniques and said, "They are all Mythic-rank techniques, but one of them has an error. It took me nearly a hundred years to find the technique with the error and correct it. If you can do so faster, I'll make you my successor."
Yuan nodded, "Alright."
Although the trial seemed simple enough, it actually required Yuan to reach a profound understanding of all ten Mythic-rank cultivation techniques and find the one with an error.
Just learning a single Mythic-rank cultivation technique would take decades for even talented cultivators, much less understanding them enough to spot errors.
"You can come directly to me at the top of the tower once you are done," said Meng Xuan before leaving.
Ming Wu didn't linger and followed Meng Xuan.
Once he was alone, Yuan laid out the cultivation techniques before him and began studying them.

If Yuan had been an ordinary cultivator, having access to so many Mythic-rank cultivation techniques would have been a life-altering event. However, due to his unique physique, Yuan had little need for cultivation techniques anymore. His body naturally absorbed spiritual energy at a rate far beyond what even the most powerful cultivation techniques could achieve, and he could also gather spiritual energy by consuming monster cores. For him, a cultivation technique was almost redundant.

While Yuan studied the techniques, Meng Xuan focused on creating a cultivation technique at the top of the tower. She was confident that Yuan would be able to pass her trial, but she could've never anticipated how fast he'd be able to do it.
Fourteen days after Meng Xuan gave Yuan the trial, she noticed someone had entered her floor.
When she opened the door and saw Yuan standing outside, her eyes widened with disbelief.
"What are you doing here so soon? Don't tell me you've already finished the task...?"
Yuan nodded and said, "Yes."
Meng Xuan narrowed her eyes and said, "Oh? Then tell me, which technique had the error?"

Yuan replied with a smile on his face, "I must admit, you fooled me for a bit. After going through all ten cultivation techniques, I couldn't find any errors in them. I doubted myself a little, so I went through them again, hence why it took this long. There are no errors in those cultivation techniques you gave me."

Meng Xuan silently stared at Yuan for a long moment before she burst out laughing, "Amazing! Truly amazing! I cannot fathom how you've managed to complete this task so soon, but here you are! Alright, I'll make you my successor—No... I wouldn't mind even if you took my position as Tower Master right this moment!"
"What do you even do as the Tower Master?" Yuan asked.
"Everything—from correcting cultivation techniques to improving them. Of course, you also need to know how to create them. Have you ever created a cultivation technique before?"

Yuan pondered for a moment before shaking his head, "I've created plenty of martial techniques before, but I've never created a cultivation technique before—at least, I don't have any memories of doing so."

"Well, there's no need to rush. Despite being at the Cultivation Tower for tens of thousands of years, I have only created a single cultivation technique. I am in the process of creating my second one."
Yuan nodded.

sentences.text: "Y-you're done?
It's only been two days, you know?
There's no way you finished two Ancient-rank techniques in two days," Ming Wu shook his head, refusing to believe Yuan.
"Allow me to prove it."
However, Ming Wu raised his hand and said, "Wait!
Let me contact someone first!"
"Give me some time.
I'll be back soon."
Without offering any further explanation, Ming Wu turned and left, disappearing to an unknown destination.
A few hours later, Ming Wu returned, but he wasn't alone.
Walking beside him was a stunningly beautiful woman, her presence commanding attention with an air of elegance and grace.
"This is the Tower Master," Ming Wu said.
"My name is Meng Xuan.
Ming Wu told me that you have managed to improve an Ancient-rank technique and fix another in just two days.
I never expected someone from the Martial Tower to have such talents with cultivation techniques.
Can you show me how you improved the techniques?" she said.
Yuan nodded and immediately began demonstrating the improved cultivation techniques.
Meng Xuan's eyes widened after seeing the improvements made to the techniques.
Both techniques that Ming Wu had given Yuan as a test were cultivation techniques the Cultivation Tower had planned on working on next, so there was no way Yuan could have cheated.
"Marvelous!" Meng Xuan exclaimed after seeing the improvements.
"Although they're only Ancient-rank techniques, you've managed to improve them so much that they qualify for a rank promotion!
This rarely happens to cultivation techniques!" she continued.
Unlike martial techniques, which can often be elevated to higher ranks through improvements due to their inherently adaptable nature, cultivation techniques are far more rigid and complex.
They rarely undergo improvements so profound that they result in a promotion of the technique's rank, as their foundational principles are much harder to alter or refine.
"And it only took you two days to do so!
Such talents are rarely seen nowadays.
How about this?
I have been looking for a successor for some time now, but nobody in the Cultivation Tower has managed to impress me.
If you can pass one more trial, I can make you the next Tower Master!"
"What?!" Ming Wu exclaimed in shock.
"Tower Master, he just joined us recently!
If you make him your successor, the others will not be happy about this!" "I know.
That's why I want to give him a few more tests.
Also, it's not like he'll immediately take my position.
I still need to train him," said Meng Xuan.
"Still, that isn't fair to the others, who have been striving to be your successor for many decades!" Ming Wu said.
Hearing this, Meng Xuan sneered, "I'm surprised you can utter such words without feeling ashamed.
The only thing that matters to me is your talent and ability to improve cultivation techniques.
I don't care how long you've been in the Cultivation Tower."
"T-that's..." Ming Wu lowered his head after being lectured by Meng Xuan.
"I'll do it," Yuan responded a moment later.
"Great."
Meng Xuan retrieved ten techniques and said, "They are all Mythic-rank techniques, but one of them has an error.
It took me nearly a hundred years to find the technique with the error and correct it.
If you can do so faster, I'll make you my successor."
Yuan nodded, "Alright."
Although the trial seemed simple enough, it actually required Yuan to reach a profound understanding of all ten Mythic-rank cultivation techniques and find the one with an error.
Just learning a single Mythic-rank cultivation technique would take decades for even talented cultivators, much less understanding them enough to spot errors.
"You can come directly to me at the top of the tower once you are done," said Meng Xuan before leaving.
Ming Wu didn't linger and followed Meng Xuan.
Once he was alone, Yuan laid out the cultivation techniques before him and began studying them.
If Yuan had been an ordinary cultivator, having access to so many Mythic-rank cultivation techniques would have been a life-altering event.
However, due to his unique physique, Yuan had little need for cultivation techniques anymore.

His body naturally absorbed spiritual energy at a rate far beyond what even the most powerful cultivation techniques could achieve, and he could also gather spiritual energy by consuming monster cores.
For him, a cultivation technique was almost redundant.
While Yuan studied the techniques, Meng Xuan focused on creating a cultivation technique at the top of the tower.
She was confident that Yuan would be able to pass her trial, but she could've never anticipated how fast he'd be able to do it.
Fourteen days after Meng Xuan gave Yuan the trial, she noticed someone had entered her floor.
When she opened the door and saw Yuan standing outside, her eyes widened with disbelief.
"What are you doing here so soon?
Don't tell me you've already finished the task...?"
Yuan nodded and said, "Yes."
Meng Xuan narrowed her eyes and said, "Oh?
Then tell me, which technique had the error?"
Yuan replied with a smile on his face, "I must admit, you fooled me for a bit.
After going through all ten cultivation techniques, I couldn't find any errors in them.
I doubted myself a little, so I went through them again, hence why it took this long.
There are no errors in those cultivation techniques you gave me."
Meng Xuan silently stared at Yuan for a long moment before she burst out laughing, "Amazing!
Truly amazing!
I cannot fathom how you've managed to complete this task so soon, but here you are!
Alright, I'll make you my successor—No...
I wouldn't mind even if you took my position as Tower Master right this moment!"
"What do you even do as the Tower Master?" Yuan asked.
"Everything—from correcting cultivation techniques to improving them.
Of course, you also need to know how to create them.
Have you ever created a cultivation technique before?"

Yuan pondered for a moment before shaking his head, "I've created plenty of martial techniques before, but I've never created a cultivation technique before—at least, I don't have any memories of doing so."
"Well, there's no need to rush.
Despite being at the Cultivation Tower for tens of thousands of years, I have only created a single cultivation technique.
I am in the process of creating my second one."
Yuan nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 1775 Successor of the Cultivation Tower
paragraphs: "Now that you're my successor and apprentice, I'll have you call me Master," said Meng Xuan with a slight smile on her face.
Yuan nodded and said, "Master, before we start training, I would like to check out the other Breakthrough Towers."
"Why? Is the Cultivation Tower and Martial Tower not enough for you?" Meng Xuan asked with a slight frown on her face.

"You're right. I am not satisfied with just these options," Yuan admitted. "As a cultivator, I want to ensure my future is as bright as possible, so I want to visit the other towers and see what I can learn from them as well."

It was an excuse Meng Xuan couldn't argue against. She understood his perspective—after all, striving for a better future was something most people, including herself, aspired to achieve. Blaming Yuan for such a mindset would have been unreasonable.
"Fine, but try not to stay there for too long," she said a moment later.
Yuan nodded with a smile, "Of course. Thank you for being understanding, Master."

However, Yuan didn't immediately leave the Cultivation Tower. He decided to explore other floors first to see if he could find anything suspicious about the tower. Unfortunately, even after searching through every floor he was permitted to visit as the Tower Master's successor, he couldn't find anything that could put the Cultivation Tower in a bad light.
'This trial might be harder than it appears...' Yuan just came to this realization.

Moreover, he still needed to visit the Alchemy Tower and Array Tower. While his experience in arrays and formations has improved significantly due to Yu Ning's occasional teachings, he wasn't sure it would be enough to satisfy the Array Tower's requirements.
As for the Alchemy Tower, besides learning the basics, he'd barely touched alchemy, so there was a good chance he wouldn't qualify to join them.
'I guess I'll figure it out when I get there.'
With that in mind, Yuan left the Cultivation Tower to visit the other towers.
The first thing Yuan noticed after exiting the Cultivation Tower was Apprentice Huan, who was standing outside.
Although it'd already been longer than a month—longer than the time limit Senior Liao had given him, Apprentice Huan hadn't given up on trying to bring Yuan back to the Metal Tower.
"What will it take for you to return to the Metal Tower with me?" Apprentice Huan asked as he followed Yuan to the teleportation formation.
"I already told you. If you want me to return to the Metal Tower, you better get Liao Tian to invite me personally."
"T-that's..."
"What? You still think I am not worth his time? Not only have I acquired Lord Zi's approval, but I've even managed to become the Cultivation Tower's successor," Yuan said.
"What?! You became the Cultivation Tower's successor?!" Apprentice Huan exclaimed loudly, his face filled with shock.
Yuan showed Apprentice Huan the badge Meng Xuan gave him before he left.
"If you don't believe me, you can ask Meng Xuan yourself."
Apprentice Huan sighed, "Who am I to speak to the Tower Master? Senior Liao is the Metal Tower's Tower Master, too."
"I have said what I need to. It's up to you whether you listen to me or not. I visited the Metal Tower first, but you drove me away, so this is a grave you dug yourself."
Yuan stepped onto the teleportation formation and said, "Bring me to the Array Tower."
Once Yuan disappeared, Apprentice Huan remained standing outside the teleportation formation with a pondering look on his face.
Sometime later, he stepped onto the formation and said, "The Metal Tower."
Upon arriving at the Metal Tower, Apprentice Huan made his way to the highest floor of the tower.

"What are you doing here, Apprentice Huan?" someone asked, standing outside Liao Tian's doors. His gaze was sharp, and his tone carried curiosity and suspicion as he inquired about Apprentice Huan's reason for being there.
"I have an urgent matter with Senior Liao," he said.
"You're just a mere Apprentice. What business could you possibly have with the Tower Master that's more important than mine?" sneered the man, who was several ranks above Apprentice Huan.
The door suddenly opened, and Liao Tian walked out, carrying a dignified aura around him.
"Tower Master—"
Just as the man opened his mouth to greet, Liao Tian interrupted, his gaze focused on Apprentice Huan.

"I was going to forgive your tardiness since you managed to bring that individual back," Liao Tian said, his voice cold and unyielding. "But what is going on here, Apprentice Huan? Why are you alone?"
As he spoke, killing intent began to emanate from his body, causing the air around him to grow heavy with pressure.
Not just Apprentice Huan, but the other guy there trembled in fear.
"I thought I said not to return unless you have that individual with you. Are my words meaningless to you?"

"That's not it!" Apprentice Huan exclaimed, his voice shaky as his legs trembled uncontrollably. "I found him and tried to convince him to return, but he wouldn't listen! He even dared to say that he'll only come back to the Metal Tower if you, Senior Liao, personally invite him back!"
His fear was evident as he struggled to steady himself under Liao Tian's intimidating presence.
"Which bold bastards dare to utter such non—"
"Shut the fuck up!" Liao Tian roared at the man who tried to join the conversation.
Apprentice Huan continued, "That man not only managed to join the Martial Tower and received Lord Zi's approval but he's also managed to become the Cultivation Tower's successor!"
Liao Tian's eyes narrowed at this shocking information.
'Martial Tower and Cultivation Tower, huh? Well, it doesn't really matter who he belongs to since I am only after the treasure in his possession,' Liao Tian thought to himself.
After pondering for a moment, Liao Tian said, "Where is he right now?"
"He went to the Array Tower before we separated!"
"Very well. If he wants me to personally see him, I shall do just that."
As Liao Tian walked past Apprentice Huan to reach the exit, his arm flickered.
The next second, Apprentice Huan's body exploded into a bloody mess.
"Clean up this mess, but don't throw away the materials," Liao Tian said to the other man without turning around.
"A-as you wish, Tower Master!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1776 Level 4 Array Master
paragraphs: After arriving in the city home to the Array Tower, Yuan was immediately struck by the sheer number of formations that filled the area. The bustling streets were a showcase of intricate arrays and formations, seamlessly integrated into everyday life. From glowing defensive barriers that protected the buildings to automated market stalls and transportation platforms powered by arrays.
Compared to all the other places Yuan had visited in the Nine Heavens, this city had an almost futuristic appearance.

Moreover, the formations grew increasingly impressive as Yuan approached the Array Tower. The tower itself was a marvel of formation craftsmanship, its structure covered in profound Tier 7 and above formations that radiated an aura of power and complexity.

Out of the five Breakthrough Towers, the Array Tower was undeniably the most protected and powerful. Attacking it would be akin to trying to breach a fortress where you could be attacked in every direction, regardless of your location.
At the entrance of the Array Tower was a sign that read, "Only Level 5 Array Masters and above qualify to take the entrance exam to join the Array Tower."

"Level 5 Array Master, huh?" Yuan was currently a Level 2 Array Master, though this was primarily because he hadn't yet taken the assessments for the higher levels. His true knowledge and capabilities surpassed his official rank.

Occasionally, Yu Ning, with her extensive expertise, would lecture Yuan, helping to deepen his understanding of the art. While these lessons weren't frequent, they were more than enough to help him become a Level 4 Array Master.
"I need to somehow improve my array skills to level 5 before I can even attempt to join the Array Tower..."
Yuan left the Array Tower and began wandering the city in hopes of finding something, as he couldn't ask for Yu Ning's help since she was sent to the spectator's room.

However, not wanting to stress out Tan Songyun, Yuan had them sent to a second spectator's room, so while Tan Songyun occupied a room herself, Xiao Hua, Feng Yuxiang, Yu Ning, and Yingzi also occupied their own rooms.
As for Zi Xuan, Ji Ran, and Dragon Goddess Yeyou, they remained within Yuan's Soul Weapons. That said, Yuan wouldn't be able to contact them until the trial ended.
Sometime later, Yuan stopped in front of a specific building.
"Array Masters' Association."
Such a sign was grandly displayed on this building.
"I should improve my rank first," he muttered to himself as he entered the building.
When Yuan got close enough, the young man standing by the entrance asked, "How can we help you today?"
Yuan retrieved his Level 2 Array Master badge and showed it to the young man.
"I'm here for a promotion."
"Of course! Please, follow me."

Yuan followed the young man into a spacious room, where three individuals were already seated behind desks. Their authoritative auras were palpable, radiating a sense of power and experience that immediately set the tone of the room. It was clear that these three were the judges responsible for overseeing his assessment. They studied Yuan with discerning eyes, their expressions neutral but their scrutiny evident.
"State your name and current rank," said the old man sitting in the middle.
"I am a Level 2 Array Master, Yuan."
"Then you'll be partaking in a level 3 assessment. I want you to create a hundred level 3 array symbols within 10 seconds. You have half a minute to prepare yourself."
Yuan then said, "I can start now."
Without any hesitation, he began writing in the air, creating a hundred flawless level 3 array symbols in only a little over two seconds.
The judges' eyes widened with awe and surprise after seeing his flawless array symbols. They couldn't believe how quickly Yuan had managed to create such beautiful symbols in such a short time.
"You don't plan on stopping after passing the level 3 assessment, correct?" one of them suddenly asked.
Yuan nodded, "I plan on taking the level 4 and level 5 assessment as well."
Even if he wasn't confident in passing the level 5 assessment, he still wanted to try it and see how close he was to being one.
"Very well."
They continued the assessment shortly after.
The three judges began creating their own level 3 formations. Once they were done, they had Yuan try to replicate it to the best of his abilities.
Familiar with this process, Yuan copied them flawlessly.
"You pass."
The judges nodded with satisfied looks on their faces.
For the final test, Yuan had to create a level 3 formation that wasn't just used by the judges, and he had three minutes to do so.
Yuan didn't spend much time pondering and randomly picked one—not that he knew many level 3 formations.
Sometime later, Yuan finished the formation.
"Congratulations, you have passed the assessment. Do you wish to take the level 4 assessment right away? Of course, you can return another day to take it."
"I want to take the level four formation right now."
The judges nodded.
"Then, for your first test, you must create forty level 4 and three hundred level 3 array symbols within 30 seconds. You have a minute to prepare, or you can start before then."
Yuan didn't immediately start. He took about ten seconds to mentally prepare himself before he started writing in the air.

It took him seven seconds to finish all three hundred level 3 array symbols, but the level 4 array symbols were much more complex and tricky. Although he only had to create forty of them, it took him almost as long as it took him to create the level 3 array symbols.
Next, he had to copy the judges' level 4 formations, most of them consisting of around five hundred symbols.
Several minutes later, Yuan easily passed the second test and moved on to the final one. Sure enough, he passed it with flying colors as well, becoming a Level 4 Array Master in no time.

chapters.title: Chapter 1777 Level 5 Array Master
paragraphs: "Are you going to take the level 5 assessment immediately, too?" one of the judges asked Yuan after he passed the level 4 assessment.
"If I fail it, how long do I have to wait for a second chance?" Yuan asked, just in case.
"You will need to wait six months before you can attempt another assessment if you fail."
"Oh... In that case, I'll wait a little longer before I take the assessment. By the way, I can borrow manuals of level 5 array symbols from the Array Masters' Association, correct?"

The judge sitting in the middle nodded and said, "As long as you are part of our Array Masters' Association, we will naturally help you reach the next rank. Since you show promise, I am willing to give you personal lessons. What do you think? I am a Level 6 Array Master, so I definitely qualify to teach you."
Yuan nodded and said, "I will humbly accept your offer, Senior."
"My name's Hao Chen, but you can just call me Senior Hao."
"Yes, Senior Hao!"
"Are you busy right now?" Hao Chen then asked.
"No."
"Good, then we'll begin your lecture now. Follow me."
Yuan nodded and followed the old man to a room located near the peak of the building.
"I can't believe Senior Hao took a liking to that young man so quickly," said one of the other two judges after they left.
"Senior Hao has a keen eye for talents. Did you not see how swiftly and perfectly that young man created the array symbols? He'll become a formidable Array Master in the near future."

Meanwhile, inside Hao Chen's room, he handed Yuan several books, including one that had all level 5 array symbols. "Honestly, there really isn't much to teach when it comes to array symbols, as it primarily depends on each individual's memorization ability," Hao Chen explained. "Once you've memorized the symbols, the rest is just practice. This is why most Array Masters don't necessarily need a master—they only require the right resources to advance their skills."
"That said, if you have any questions, you can ask me. I'll be studying array symbols myself." Hao Chen sat in his seat and began studying level 7 array symbols.

Yuan also began studying Level 5 array symbols. Thanks to his experience as an immortal, his memorization ability was extraordinarily powerful, allowing him to memorize complex symbols with ease. Additionally, his formidable soul strength significantly enhanced his capacity to learn and comprehend details more quickly, hence why soul cultivation techniques are exceptionally rare and sought after.
About a week later, Yuan memorized all level 5 array symbols, and he began practicing writing them. Hao Chen was greatly shocked by how swiftly Yuan had memorized the array symbols.
'There's no way he actually memorized everything from scratch in less than a week. He must've already memorized a portion of level 5 array symbols prior to coming here,' Hao Chen thought to himself.
'Still... his array symbols are too beautiful. That level of mastery requires tens of thousands of years of experience to achieve, so how can someone seemingly so young achieve it?'
Hao Chen gave Yuan three level 5 formations to study, each requiring the combination of around 500 level 5 array symbols to complete.
"Alright, I am ready to take the level 5 assessment," Yuan said to Hao Chen a few days later.
Hao Chen stared at him with wide eyes and said, "Just how strong is your soul strength? It's only been a little over a week, you know? I was expecting your company for at least a few months."
Yuan shook his head with a smile, "I don't have that much time."
"Why the rush?"
"I need to join the Array Tower as soon as possible."

"The Array Tower, huh? I used to work with them, but due to my lack of talents, I was forced to leave after just a hundred years. I didn't want to admit it back then, but alas, the Array Masters there are a different breed—sort of like you."
Sometime later, Yuan went downstairs with Hao Chen to take the level 5 assessment.
The other two judges showed up a little later.
"You're taking the level 5 assessment already? It's only been a week," one of them said to Yuan.
"I was already familiar with level 5 array symbols. I just needed a little more time to be confident in the assessment," said Yuan.
'I knew it...' Hao Chen sighed inwardly after hearing this.
"Alright."
Sometime later, Hao Chen said, "The level 5 assessment will be a little different compared to your previous trials."

"For the first trial, you'll need to create a level 5 defensive formation, and it must withstand the strength of a cultivator at the Divine King realm. You have five minutes to create the formation. You have a minute to prepare."
One of the level 5 formations that Hao Chen gave to Yuan to study happened to be a defensive formation, and Yuan decided to use it for the trial.
Two minutes later, Yuan created a defensive formation in front of him and said, "It's done."
"Very well. I will now attack it with the strength of a Divine King."
Hao Chen attacked the formation with a simple attack, which bounced right off the defensive formation.
"You pass. For the second trial, you must create a level 5 offensive formation, and it must have a certain level of power. You have ten minutes for this test and one minute to prepare."
Another formation Hao Chen gave Yuan to study also happened to be an offensive formation, almost as if he was purposefully helping Yuan prepare for the level 5 assessment.
After spending six minutes creating the formation, Yuan said, "I am finished."
Hao Chen retrieved a white talisman and tossed it inside his formation.
"Attack it."

Yuan nodded and activated the formation. In an instant, swords composed entirely of concentrated spiritual energy materialized around the room, their edges gleaming with power. The swords moved with precision, launching toward the talisman.
A barrier appeared around the talisman in an attempt to protect it, but the barrier was instantly shattered by the swords.
"Good. Now, onto the final test," Hao Chen said.

chapters.title: Chapter 1778 Array Tower
paragraphs: "For the final test, you must activate two level 5 formations—one defense and one offensive—simultaneously and keep them activated for an hour without any external assistance, such as spirit stones. You have five minutes to prepare," said Hao Chen.

Any Array Master could easily activate a single formation and sustain it using spirit stones. However, activating and maintaining two formations simultaneously was far more challenging. It required significantly more spiritual energy and placed a substantial burden on one's soul strength.
Yuan spent a few minutes mentally preparing himself. Once he was ready, he recreated the offensive formation and defensive formation he showcased during the last two tests.
After activating them, he sat down and closed his eyes to focus on maintaining the formations. Normally, this test would push most Array Masters to their limits, but Yuan felt incredibly at ease.

His spiritual energy recovery was so powerful that he could easily maintain a dozen formations simultaneously, much less two level 5 formations. As for his soul strength, it had reached the point where he couldn't even feel it depleting.
An hour passed in the blink of an eye, and Yuan passed the final trial without breaking a single drop of sweat.
"Congratulations, you are now officially a Level 5 Array Master!" Hao Chen said to him afterward.
"It was only thanks to you, Senior Hao."
"In that case, don't forget about me when you make it big in the Array Tower," Hao Chen laughed merrily.
Yuan left the Array Masters' Association shortly after and made his way back to the Array Tower.
Once he returned to the Array Tower, Yuan approached the closed entrance, where a powerful tier 5 formation kept the doors sealed.
Yuan noticed the formation before he became a Level 5 Array Master, but he did not have the means to unseal it.
He proceeded to spend several hours trying to crack the formation. Despite the formation being a level 5 formation, it could qualify as a level 6 array solely due to its complexity.
Eventually, Yuan cracked the formation, unsealing the doors.
When Yuan stepped into the Array Tower, an ordinary-looking young woman greeted him just slightly beyond the entrance.
"Congratulations, you have qualified to take the assessment to join our Array Tower. Would you like to take the assessment right now?"

As the woman spoke, her gaze landed on Yuan's tower badges. Her eyes widened with surprise, as it was quite rare to see an individual associated with two towers simultaneously, especially the Martial Tower and Cultivation Tower.
"I would," Yuan nodded in response.
"Very well. If you could follow me, please."
Yuan followed the young woman to an empty room, where another individual was waiting.
This person was a middle-aged woman with dark green hair.
"In order to join our Array Tower, you must defeat me using level 5 array formations only," said the green-haired woman.
"We will both have ten minutes to prepare a defensive formation around our body. Then, we will attack using attack formations. Whoever breaks their opponent's defensive formation wins."
"Any questions?"
"Am I allowed to use formations lower than level 5?"
"Yes, anything below level 5 formations are allowed."
Yuan nodded.
"Then we will begin in right now."
Both Yuan and the green-haired woman began working on their defensive formation.

Yuan finished his level 5 defensive formation less than three minutes into the match. Seeing this, the green-haired woman sneered inwardly, 'What a fool, rushing his defensive formation. Not only is he using one formation, but he didn't even bother to refine it.'

A formation can be strengthened in two primary ways. The first is through refinement, where the Array Master redraws or recreates the formation, layering it over the existing one to enhance its power.

The second method involves using treasures and external resources to amplify the formation's effects. However, for an assessment like this, relying on external aids was clearly not an option, leaving Yuan to rely solely on his skills and endurance.

The green-haired woman finished her defensive formation nine and a half minutes later. She was going to create more than one defensive formation, but seeing how Yuan was still a beginner, she didn't bother doing so, looking down on him.
"We will begin now," said the green-haired woman.
Yuan nodded and immediately started creating hundreds of level 1 array symbols every second.
'This bastard, he's using level 1 array symbols?' The green-haired woman raised her eyebrows and thought to herself as she worked on her level 5 array symbols.
Due to how fast Yuan was creating his array symbols, he finished creating dozens of attack formations around the woman.
"Activate."
The formations attacked the woman's defensive formation, leaving tiny cracks on the surface every time they struck. However, these cracks quickly recovered in the blink of an eye.
"The power is quite lacking..." Yuan muttered after seeing the results.
Meanwhile, the woman was shocked that his level 1 attack formations could even damage her level 5 defensive formation.
'His soul strength must be as high as the heavens!' she cried inwardly, almost fumbling her attack formation from the shock.
After his initial attack, Yuan didn't attack again, as he wanted to see how much his defensive formation could endure.
Once the woman finished her level 5 offensive formation, she immediately activated it and attacked Yuan's defensive formation.
A strong explosion consumed Yuan's figure and formation a moment later.

Inside the cloud of dust and smoke, Yuan could see that his defensive formation had barely been affected by the attack, with only slight cracks that healed instantly. Seeing this, he continued his assault, using level 2 attack formations.

By the time the smoke and dust settled a few moments later, Yuan had created over a dozen level 2 attack formations, using them to attack the woman, who was in disbelief and couldn't believe that Yuan's defensive formation had managed to survive her attack.
'How?! His formation should've been heavily damaged if not outright destroyed by that attack just now!' she cried inwardly, her eyes wide with disbelief as Yuan's attack stuck her formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1779 Array Tower(2)
paragraphs: When Yuan's Level 2 attack formations struck the woman's defensive formation, the impact was powerful enough to cause the entire thing to shake and large cracks to appear on its surface. The woman gritted her teeth as she poured her spiritual energy into the formation, quickly restoring it. However, the damage to her formation had also depleted some of her soul strength, something not easily recoverable.
'Not good! At this rate, his level 3 attack formations will be enough to destroy my defensive formation!'
The woman started casting level 3 array symbols just like Yuan since she would be able to attack much faster.
Yuan completed his array symbols a full two seconds before the woman, and in the world of Array Masters, even a fraction of a second could determine the victor, much less two seconds.

Seeing that Yuan launched his attacks before she could, the woman swiftly transferred half of her focus from offensive to defensive, strengthening her formation with a tremendous amount of spiritual energy.

However, even with her defensive formation enhanced, Yuan's level 3 attack formation was still strong enough to penetrate her barrier. Yet, it wasn't enough to completely destroy the barrier, as the holes would heal faster than Yuan could damage it.

The woman had managed to survive Yuan's onslaught, but it'd cost her dearly, and more than half of her spiritual energy was exhausted in that brief moment. Moreover, focusing on two different things took a toll on her soul strength.
Fortunately, she was able to finish creating her level 3 attack formations, and she bombarded Yuan's barrier the very next moment.
Seeing this, Yuan decided to strengthen his own barrier with his spiritual energy.
When the woman's attacks struck Yuan's barrier, they bounced off effortlessly, leaving the barrier completely unscathed. Not even the faintest scratch appeared on its surface.
The unexpected result left the woman utterly speechless, her disbelief evident as she stared at the barrier in stunned silence.
At that moment, Yuan finished a level 4 attack formation, attacking her barrier with it.
Clang!

The woman's barrier was shattered like glass after being struck by a rock despite her swift reaction and attempt to exhaust the rest of her spiritual energy to enhance her barrier. Unfortunately, even with all of her spiritual energy, she was unable to defend herself against a single level 4 attack formation from Yuan.

The woman fell to her knees and began gasping for air as her face dripped with sweat. Their battle had only lasted for a few minutes, but it was enough to completely exhaust her spiritual energy and soul strength.
"You... win," she announced sometime later after coming back from her shock.
"That was my first battle as an Array Master. It was quite fun. Thanks for the experience," Yuan bowed to her.
"Your first time...?" The woman stared at him with wide eyes.

She eventually shook her head, dismissing his remark as a joke, and said, "Anyway, you've passed the test and officially qualify to join our Array Tower." Her tone was composed, but there was an undeniable hint of acknowledgment in her voice.
"By the way, my name is Wan Qing."
"Yuan."
"Here is your badge, Yuan," Wan Qing handed him a badge that had several powerful formations hidden within.

Yuan subconsciously inspected the formations. Seeing his serious face, Wan Qing chuckled, "Relax, the formations inside that badge are there to protect you since the badge can also be used as a life-saving treasure."
Sure enough, Yuan confirmed that the formations were all defensive formations—except one.
"Why is there a tracker in here?" Yuan asked with raised eyebrows.

"Unlike the other towers, our Array Tower frequently sends its Array Masters out to assist those in need of our expertise," she explained. "The tracker is an additional layer of safety. In case we're kidnapped or killed, it can detect if our life is in danger, as well as help locate us."
"What a convenient thing," Yuan muttered.
"By the way, what is the ranking structure like in the Array Tower?" Yuan then asked.
"It's similar to that Array Masters' Association, but we start from level 5—going all the way to level 9. If you want to increase your rank, you'll also need to improve your Array Master level."
"I see..."
Yuan immediately began pondering. There was simply no way he could become a level 9 Array Master in a few months—before the time limit for his reward expires.
'Looks like I will have to sneak around this place, just like the Alchemy Tower.'
"I understand. Thank you."

Wan Qing handed him a scroll and said, "This is a list of things we expect you to do while part of the Array Tower. Make sure to read it because if you fail to do even a single thing on the list, you'll be kicked out of the tower."
Yuan accepted the scroll and took a look at it.

The Array Tower required its Array Masters to fulfill at least one mission a year. These missions are typically business requests sent to the Array Towers. For example, a sect would like to create a powerful formation around their territory, so they contact the Array Tower. Of course, whether the Array Tower accepted the request or not was a different story.
The next thing on the list required Array Masters below level 7 to reach that level within three hundred years. Failure to reach level 7 before the time limit would result in expulsion.
'Safe to say none of these rules matter to me.'
Yuan didn't even bother reading the rest of the list and tossed it inside his spatial ring.
"What are you going to do now that you're part of the Array Tower?" Wan Qing suddenly asked with a curious face.
"I'm going to the Alchemy Tower," he responded with a smile.
Wan Qing stared at him with wide eyes and muttered, "Are you trying to join every single tower out there?"
"Yes, I am."
"Why?"
"Why not?" Yuan shrugged, leaving her speechless.

chapters.title: Chapter 1780 Alchemy Tower
paragraphs: "Anyway, before you leave for the Alchemy Tower, let me show you around our Array Tower," said Wan Qing.
"Sure."
Thus, Wan Qing began showing Yuan around the tower. The Array Tower was much less restrictive than the other towers, so they were able to visit almost every floor.

Like the other towers, the array masters in the Array Tower have different roles. Some focus on creating new formations, while others improve existing ones. Wan Qing, specifically, specialized in improving formations.
"How long have you been studying arrays?" Wan Qing asked as they walked around.
"Not long. I started learning the basics a few years ago, and I am currently learning from a Level 7 Array Master."
"A level 7 Array Master, huh? I wonder when I'll reach that level. I was just promoted to level 6, so it'll probably take some time."

After the tour, Wan Qing led Yuan back to the first floor and said, "Well, good luck at the Alchemy Tower. They have the strictest requirements out of the five Breakthrough Towers—at least according to rumors."
"Thank you," Yuan nodded.
After leaving the Array Tower, Yuan made his way to the Alchemy Tower.

'I have visited four Breakthrough Towers, but none of them gave me any bad vibes... No... I have only been to the first floor of the Metal Tower, so I cannot really judge them with my current knowledge.'
Moreover, he has yet to investigate the towers properly, including the three he'd already joined.

Sometime later, Yuan arrived in the city housing the Alchemy Tower. The moment he stepped out of the teleportation formation, a potent aroma of medicinal herbs and concoctions filled the air, immediately assaulting his senses.
"Tier 5 pills! We have Tier 5 pills for sale!"
"Come get your Burning Lotus Pills here! Only available in this store!"
As Yuan made his way toward the Alchemy Tower, he noticed that nearly every street he passed featured at least one medicine store.

Yuan ignored the bustling noise and shouting around him as he followed the path leading directly to the Alchemy Tower. However, when he was almost at his destination, he suddenly came to a halt when he felt a weak tug on his robes.
Turning around, he saw a young boy with a homeless appearance clutching the lower part of his robes, his small, dirty hand holding on tightly as he looked up at Yuan.
"What's the matter?"
"Big brother, have you seen my mother?"
"No, I haven't."
"Are you sure? She left a week ago, heading toward the place you seem to be going right now," he said.
"I've only just arrived at this city today, so there's no way I could've seen her, who left a week ago."
"I see... Then she must be inside that tower. Are you heading to the tower now?"
Yuan nodded.
"In that case, can you tell her to return to me if you see her? I miss her."
"What does she look like?"
The little boy gave him a brief description.
"Alright. I'll let your mother know if I see her inside the tower."
"Thank you!"
The little boy turned around and ran away.

Yuan watched the little boy disappear into the alley, a strange feeling settling in his stomach. By now, he was too familiar with the workings of the Stairway to Heaven to not realize that the boy had nothing to do with the trial. However, since he lacked information, he decided to ignore it for now and continued making his way to the Alchemy Tower.

When Yuan reached the entrance of the Alchemy Tower and took in the scene before him, he was immediately reminded of the Metal Tower. Much like its counterpart, the first floor appeared to function as a bustling marketplace, with stalls and shops dedicated to selling various medical products, from herbs and pills to rare ingredients.
There was also a sign outside the entrance that read, "Pill Grandmasters must qualify to join the Alchemy Tower. Alchemy Emperors and above may join the Alchemy Tower without needing any assessment."
"Pill Grandmasters are Tier 5 Alchemists, and Alchemy Emperors are Tier 6..." Yuan muttered to himself.
He had only managed to concoct a tier 1 pill before, and the chances of him becoming a Tier 5 Alchemist before the reward time limit were slim to none.
'I definitely won't have the time to become a Tier 5 Alchemist and investigate the towers. Since I have no choice, let's just sneak around the Alchemy Tower.'
With that in mind, Yuan entered the Alchemy Tower to begin his snooping around.
'In order to even visit the other floors, I will need a badge from someone who works in the Alchemy Tower...'

There was a minor teleportation formation that connected every floor in the tower, and only those with a badge could access the formation. However, being a Level 5 Array Master, Yuan had a feeling he could crack the formation.

After activating Shadow Veil, Yuan's body became shrouded in a dark, ethereal veil, completely erasing his presence from the senses of those around him. Cloaked in this shadowy aura, he moved silently toward the teleportation formation on the other side of the building.

Despite walking past thousands of people, not a single individual seemed aware of his presence. Even those who looked directly at him gazed past him as if he were invisible, completely oblivious to his existence.
The area around the teleport formation was empty since it could only be accessed by the Alchemists of the Alchemy Tower. Seeing this, Yuan took his time to analyze the formation.
'Thankfully, this formation is only level 5, even if it's slightly more complex than usual.'
After spending many minutes analyzing the formation, Yuan managed to crack it, gaining access to it without needing a badge.
Yuan thought about going straight to the peak of the tower but decided to search from floor to floor, starting from the second floor.
Once he was prepared, he stepped into the teleport formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 1781 Alchemy Tower(2)
paragraphs: Upon entering the second floor, Yuan found himself in a vast research room with hundreds of Alchemists bustling about with scrolls and medicine in their grasp.

Yuan, still in his Shadow Veil, walked around like he owned the place. Due to how busy and focused everyone there was, Yuan was able to investigate the whole floor without any issues. Hell, he could even do jumping jacks in front of someone and they still wouldn't notice him.
It was almost as if Shadow Veil's effect was similar to the Celestial Emperor's curse, where it naturally made everyone oblivious to Yuan's existence.
This level of concealment was heaven-defying, and if the world knew of its existence, there would be wars to acquire it.

Through his observations on the second floor, Yuan quickly realized that everyone there was engaged in the process of creating new pill recipes. He also noticed that the recipes being developed were relatively basic, ranging from Tier 1 to Tier 2.
The next floor was the same as the second floor, but the pills being created were much more complex, ranging from Tier 3 to Tier 4.

This went on for the next several floors until he reached the 11th floor, where there were many rooms with closed doors. Yuan used his divine sense to peek inside these rooms to find Alchemists at work inside.
Not wanting to risk detection, Yuan took only quick glances into each room as he moved steadily from floor to floor.

The moment Yuan stepped onto the 30th floor, the atmosphere shifted drastically. The pristine environment of the lower levels was replaced by a grim, unsettling corridor lined with prison cells. The air felt heavy, and the dim lighting cast eerie shadows across the cold, grimy walls, starkly contrasting the clean and orderly nature of the floors below.

As Yuan peered into the prison cells, he saw live magical beasts confined within them. Considering the crucial role magical beast materials played in alchemy, it wasn't surprising for the Alchemy Tower to house such a facility.

From their skin to their nails, almost every part of a magical beast could be utilized in alchemy. Their blood, bones, fur, organs, and especially their monster core were valuable for crafting pills, elixirs, and other alchemical creations. Because of this, Yuan didn't find the magical beast prison to be anything out of the ordinary. They were simply no different from livestock.

As Yuan continued climbing the tower, the magical beasts grew increasingly rare and powerful. Unfortunately for them, every prison cell was enforced with Level 7 formations. They were so powerful that even Yuan would have difficulty dealing with them.

A pungent stench of blood suddenly assaulted Yuan's nose when he reached the 45th floor, causing him to frown. 'This isn't the scent of magical beasts...' Yuan thought to himself as he used his divine sense to check the prison cells.
Sure enough, imprisoned on the 45th floor were not magical beasts but humans.
'Using humans as resources, huh? Why am I not surprised?' Yuan shook his head after seeing the grim situation before him.

The concept of using humans as resources for alchemy dates back to the Primordial Era, long before the emergence of demons in the world. Back then, human blood and other components were studied for their potential alchemical properties.

However, this practice was deemed highly immoral and unethical, leading to its swift prohibition. Over time, it became a forbidden art, with strict penalties for anyone who dared to pursue it, most cases being the death penalty. Despite this, whispers of its use occasionally surfaced in dark corners of the world, often associated with the most desperate or depraved Alchemists.

As Yuan continued walking down the grim corridor, his attention was drawn to one of the cells. Inside, a woman lay on the floor, seemingly asleep. Her appearance caught his eye, as her features closely matched the description the homeless little boy had given him earlier.
However, before he could even consider rescuing her, Yuan noticed another presence appearing on his floor, forcing him to hide.

Although he needed to hide, there were no suitable places to do so in the narrow corridor. Left with no other choice, he relied entirely on his Shadow Veil and remained perfectly still. Fortunately for him, the darkness of the area enhanced the effectiveness of his skill, allowing him to blend seamlessly into the shadows and remain undetected.

The other presence belonged to a middle-aged man with a hunched back. However, he didn't appear to be affiliated with the Alchemy Tower, as he wasn't wearing their distinctive uniform, which all the other individuals Yuan had encountered so far had worn. Moreover, his cultivation was pathetically low, being only a Spirit Warrior.

Yuan observed silently as the hunched man unlocked the prison cell containing the little boy's mother and dragged her out. Then, Yuan followed closely behind the man as he made his way through the corridor and toward the teleport formation.
Despite Yuan trailing directly behind him, the man remained completely unaware of his presence.

The man was so oblivious to Yuan's presence that Yuan managed to step into the teleportation formation alongside him, completely undetected. Moments later, they emerged on the 60th floor—the tallest floor in the Alchemy Tower.
As the hunched man approached the only door on the 60th floor and prepared to knock, Yuan quickly concealed himself behind one of the large pillars.

Moments later, the door opened, revealing an old man dressed in the distinctive uniform of the Alchemy Tower. The old man glanced at the hunched man and spoke in a commanding tone. "Bring the material inside."
"Yes, Master."

While the two men had their backs turned, Yuan seized the opportunity. Moving like a shadow, he slipped through the open doors and entered the room undetected. Once inside, he quickly found a dark corner to hide in, ensuring he remained out of sight as he observed the scene unfolding before him.

The first thing that caught Yuan's attention inside the room was a large crimson cauldron filled nearly to the brim with blood. The pungent, metallic scent of human blood was so overpowering that Yuan had noticed it even before the door was opened.

However, the most horrifying sight in the room was the corpses suspended above the crimson cauldron. Their lifeless bodies dangled ominously, blood dripping steadily into the cauldron below, resembling the process of drying out slaughtered chickens.

chapters.title: Chapter 1782 Alchemy Tower(3)
paragraphs: The gruesome sight was enough to make Yuan's blood boil with anger, his fists clenching tightly.
However, he forced himself to remain composed, swallowing his rage as he continued to silently observe the two men, determined to uncover the full extent of their sinister actions.
Tan Songyun was covering her mouth from shock and disguise while watching this from the spectators' room.

"I remember now... That incident at the Alchemy Tower... So this was the real cause of the Tower Master's death?" Tan Songyun remembered that the Alchemy Tower's Tower Master had been assassinated once before, but not because of any accusations of being an evil cultivator. Instead, the rumors claimed he was killed over a precious pill recipe he had recently created, and naturally, Yuan—Tian Kai was blamed for the assassination.
"Please spare me... I have a son... He won't survive alone..." The woman suddenly muttered in a weak voice, "I swear I won't tell anyone about this..."

"Hmph. Someone as worthless as you should feel honored to finally have some value being part of Master's pill as its material," the hunched-back man sneered, his tone dripping with contempt as he dragged the woman closer to the crimson cauldron.
'A Spirit Warrior and... a third-level Divine Emperor, huh?'
After assessing the Tower Master's cultivation, Yuan was confident he could deal with them without too much effort.
"Master, how should I bleed this one out?" the hunched-back man asked.
The Tower Master replied, "Six-inch long cuts on the neck, wrists, and tendons."
"As you wish, Master."
The hunch-back man eagerly retrieved his ceremonial dagger and prepared to cut the woman.
Seeing this, Yuan decided to intervene.
He walked out of his hiding spot and spoke in a cold voice, "To practice human concoction during this day and age... how are you not ashamed of yourselves?"
"WHO'S THERE?!"

The Tower Master's heart skipped a beat upon hearing Yuan's unexpected voice echo through the room. Panic flashed across his face as he began looking around frantically, his eyes scanning every corner of the room. However, despite his efforts, he was unable to see or sense Yuan's presence.
'Shadow Veil is more effective than I thought...' Yuan was inwardly surprised by the results. He was essentially standing right before them, but they still couldn't see him.

Wanting to test Shadow Veil's limits, Yuan decided to keep it active, and he continued speaking, "So, what kind of pill was enticing enough to turn you into an evil practitioner?" Yuan's calm yet disgusted voice filled the room, cutting through the tension like a blade. "Judging by the amount of blood and your methods, it must be the Reserve Heavenly Pill, isn't it?"
"You know about the Reverse Heavenly Pill?!" the Tower Master shouted, his voice sharp with alarm as he scanned the room more frantically than before. "Who are you?! Show yourself!"
"Honestly, I subconsciously muttered that name out loud," Yuan admitted calmly.
As he observed the gruesome scene, fragments of Tian Kai's memories surfaced in his mind, and with them, the name of the pill.

"Ah... I remember now... Master Tower Chang Heng," Yuan said, his tone carrying a faint trace of nostalgia. "You were a renowned Tier 7 Alchemist, celebrated for your profound knowledge and vast experience in alchemy. You even created multiple powerful and groundbreaking recipes that helped you become the Alchemy Tower's Tower Master."

"Everything seemed fine for the first several centuries, but then the number of people disappearing in this city began to rise at an unnatural rate. It was alarming enough to attract my attention, so I had to investigate the cause."

"After a thorough investigation, I uncovered the gruesome truth," Yuan continued, his tone growing colder. "The Alchemy Tower was kidnapping homeless people and using them for experiments... and to concoct pills."
"The once righteous Alchemist has somehow been corrupted and become an evil practitioner."

"And for your crimes, I executed every single Alchemist who had even the slightest involvement. It caused quite the stir within the Nine Heavens back then, but in the grand scheme of things, it was merely a small ripple in a much larger wave."
"I've finally found you, you sneaky little bastard!" the Tower Master suddenly interrupted, his voice filled with fury.
Without hesitation, he unleashed a powerful attack he had been secretly preparing this entire time, sending a wave of destructive energy hurtling toward Yuan's direction.
However...
"Sorry, but I am actually over here."
Yuan's voice resounded behind the Tower Master.
Stab!
Just as the Tower Master turned his head around, Yuan stabbed him in the heart from the back with the Baneful Abyss, inflicting him with Mark of the Baneful.

The poison, having entered the Tower Master's heart directly, worked swiftly and mercilessly. With no time to counteract or expel it, his body succumbed almost instantly. Within moments, the Tower Master collapsed, his life extinguished.

After dealing with the Tower Master, Yuan turned his gaze toward the hunched-back man. Without a word, he raised a finger and unleashed a concentrated burst of Sword Aura. The attack was swift and precise, striking the hunched-back man between the eyes before he could even react, killing him instantly.
Moments passed in complete silence, the oppressive air lingering in the room as if time had frozen in place. Yet, Yuan remained inside the Alchemy Tower.

After another moment of stillness, Yuan sighed out loud, "I knew it. Although the Alchemy Tower is guilty of practicing forbidden alchemy, this trial hasn't ended yet. There are still others who need to be brought to justice."
He looked at the Tower Master's melting corpse.
"I should've probably asked him if he was working with someone before I killed him... Oh well. It's not like I have no clue."

Yuan turned his gaze toward the woman, who had fainted from exhaustion and fear. He approached her silently, gently lifting her into his arms. After activating Shadow Veil again, Yuan was pleasantly surprised to see that its effects also extended to the woman, who was in physical contact with him. However, it consumed his spiritual energy twice as fast.
Sometime later, Yuan slipped out of the Alchemy Tower as silently as he had entered. Thanks to Shadow Veil, he moved unnoticed, leaving no sign that he had ever been there.
